name: Mugen ~Kyojitsu to Shinjitsu~
source:
Hero is being forced to kill 12 warrior girls in order to reincarnate old Christianity goddess Lilith. Will he fulfill his fate or come under favor of other goddess?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被迫杀死12名女战士，以让古基督教女神莉莉丝转世。他会完成自己的命运，还是获得其他女神的眷顾？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
